name: United Kingdom (income tax, England, Wales and Northern Ireland)
notes: Non-savings, non-dividend income. Scotland has different rates and is not included.
Personal allowance £12,570, reduced by £1 for every £2 of income above £100,000 (zero from £125,140); this creates a 60% effective marginal rate between £100,000 and £125,140.
Excludes National Insurance, student loan repayments, Marriage Allowance and Blind Person's Allowance.
